welcome.description: Share your symptoms and medical history in your comfortable language before meeting the doctor. Our AI organizes your health timeline so your doctor can spend more time on your care.
welcome.feature_1_desc: Speak or tap answers in Hindi, Tamil, or English.
welcome.feature_2_desc: Support for Dashavidha Pariksha as well as modern clinical SOCRATES frameworks.
welcome.feature_3_desc: AI assists in taking notes. Your doctor always makes the diagnosis and treatment decisions.

language_select.title: Choose Your Language
language_select.subtitle: Select the language you are most comfortable speaking and reading in

identity.title: Patient Information
identity.subtitle: Provide your basic details to link your case history with your consultation

consent.title: Informed Patient Consent
consent.subtitle: Please review how your health data is gathered and protected
consent.scope_1_desc: We collect details regarding your current symptoms, discomfort, dietary habits, and past health history.
consent.scope_2_desc: To compile a structured summary for your physician so your consultation is thorough, personalized, and efficient.
consent.scope_3_desc: AI is used ONLY to organize questions and draft notes. The AI will NEVER give a medical diagnosis, NEVER prescribe medicines, and NEVER replace a physician.
consent.scope_4_desc: Your licensed doctor will review, verify, and make all medical judgments during your actual consultation.
consent.scope_5_desc: You may choose not to use this pre-intake assistant at any point and consult the doctor directly.
consent.agree_checkbox: I understand and agree to provide my health details for pre-consultation case-taking.

mode_select.title: Select Intake Consultation Mode
mode_select.subtitle: Choose the clinical framework suited for your consultation today
mode_select.clinical_desc: Standard systematic clinical history taking based on the SOCRATES framework (Site, Onset, Character, Radiation, Severity, Aggravating factors).
mode_select.ayush_desc: Holistic assessment integrating Dashavidha Pariksha (Prakriti, Vikriti, Agni/Metabolic fire, Koshtha, Ahara & Vyayama stamina).
